# G03 — CPU-complete reference renderer

**Goal:** Create original CPU coverage/SDF + heightmap/normal/bevel evaluator from a declared FrameIR. No Qt/C++, GPU or network dependency. Test holes, linearly composited translucent edge, DPR 1/2, deterministic traces and no-GPU output. E02/E05/E11.

**Write-set exclusive:** `docs/agent-results/blobin-next-01/G03.md` and `experiments/blobin-next-01/G03/**`. The latter is an original private lab, **not blob.in production source**. Do not edit other workers, shared shader code, historical blob.in snapshot, Gnosix or the in.gnu6 engine.

**Gate:** define a minimal adversarial input and reproducible outcome. Record exact source+toolchain, dependency lock, viewport/DPR, hardware when relevant, verification results and a clear unsupported/NOT_RUN path. No invented benchmark or GPU proof. CPU compatibility and identity ownership must be addressed even for GPU-specific work.

**Handoff:** original committed lab code if implemented + one evidence report; declare candidate shared interfaces as proposals; integrator reconciles after all workers finish.
